name: 信用（评估/授信/催收）管理

map.输入客户财务指标和信用记录，计算信用评分、授信额度和风险等级: Enter a customer's financial metrics and credit history to compute credit score, credit limit and risk grade.
map.基于加权评分模型：资产负债率、流动比率、收入与信用记录等指标映射分档得分后加权合: Based on a weighted scoring model: indicators such as debt-to-asset ratio, current ratio, revenue and credit history are mapped to band scores then weighted into a credit score; risk grade is set by score range with a suggested credit limit, for pre-lending assessment (results for reference only).
map.📚 深度解析：客户信用评分与授信额度: In-depth: Customer Credit Scoring and Credit Limit
map.、逾期次数与信用历史给客户打分并分级。: , overdue counts and credit history, score and grade the customer.
map.按评级对应的系数估算建议授信额度，作为审批的量化参考。: Estimate the suggested credit limit by the rating's coefficient, as a quantitative reference for approval.
map.贷后复评时用评分变化触发不同的贷后管理动作（正常跟踪 / 加强监控 / 启动催收: In post-lending review, score changes trigger different post-lending actions (normal tracking / enhanced monitoring / start collection).
map.A 客户：资产负债率 45%（25 分）、流动比率 2.2（15 分）、年营收: Customer A: debt-to-asset 45% (25 pts), current ratio 2.2 (15 pts), annual revenue 30 million (8 pts), net margin 12% (16 pts), no overdue (15 pts), credit history 6 yrs (10 pts) -> total 89 -> AAA (excellent), limit coefficient 0.3 -> suggested limit 9 million yuan, post-lend 'normal'. Customer B: debt-to-asset 72% (0 pts), current ratio 1.2 (8 pts), revenue 8 million (5 pts),
map.8%（12 分）、逾期 2 次（5 分）、信用历史 2 年（4 分）→ 34 分: 8% (12 pts), overdue 2 times (5 pts), credit history 2 yrs (4 pts) -> 34 pts -> C (doubtful), limit coefficient 0 -> no credit suggested, post-lend 'loss: legal action'.
map.授信额度是怎么算的？: How is the credit limit computed?
Limit = annual revenue * rating coefficient. The coefficient decreases with rating: AAA 0.30, AA 0.25, A 0.20, BBB 0.15, BB 0.10, B 0.05, C is 0. This is only a quantitative pre-screen reference; actual credit also considers collateral, industry and policy.
map.评级区间怎么划分？: How are the rating bands divided?
map.≥85 AAA（极优）、≥75 AA（优秀）、≥65 A（良好）、≥55 BBB: >=85 AAA (excellent), >=75 AA (very good), >=65 A (good), >=55 BBB (average), >=45 BB (watch), >=35 B (substandard), <35 C (doubtful). Max score 100, capped after summing the six dimensions.
map.企业信用评估管理工具，输入财务指标和信用记录，计算信用评分、信用等级、授信额度建: Corporate credit assessment tool: enter financial metrics and credit history to compute credit score, credit grade, suggested credit limit and collection strategy.
map.信用评分 = 六项指标分档给分直接累加（无权重乘法，封顶 min(100, Σ): Credit score = the six metrics are scored by tier and summed directly (no weight multiplication, capped at min(100, sum)): debt-to-asset ratio ≤50%→25 / ≤60→20 / ≤70→15 / ≤80→8; current ratio ≥2→15 / ≥1.5→12 / ≥1→8 / ≥0.5→4; annual revenue (10k) ≥10000→15 / ≥5000→12 / ≥1000→8 / ≥500→5 / otherwise 2; net profit margin ≥15%→20 / ≥10→16 / ≥5→12 / ≥0→6; 0 overdue payments→15 / ≤1→10 / ≤3→5; credit history ≥5 years→10 / ≥3→7 / ≥1→4. Credit line = annual revenue x score-tier coefficient (≥85→0.3, ≥75→0.25, ≥65→0.2, ≥55→0.15, ≥45→0.1, ≥35→0.05, otherwise 0). Validation: no strict validation, missing values default to 0. Criteria: score ≥85 AAA, ≥75 AA, ≥65 A, ≥55 BBB, ≥45 BB, ≥35 B, <35 C; collection strategy ≥65 normal - periodic tracking, ≥55 special mention - enhanced monitoring, ≥45 substandard - start collection, ≥35 doubtful - on-site collection, otherwise loss - legal action.
